doctor_description: Diagnoses runtimes, binaries and tool versions against the lock file, classifies what is missing (essential, optional or unused) and, on a terminal or with --fix, offers to install it.
doctor_header_not_ready: Environment with pending items: {absent} absent, {incompatible} incompatible.
doctor_note: A ready environment is neither a valid plan nor an approved result: they are different states.
doctor_option_fix: Offers to install what is missing even when nothing essential is missing (on a terminal, it asks first).
doctor_option_yes: With --fix: installs the essential items without asking (Docker, a system command, still asks for a confirmation on the terminal).
doctor_option_include_optional: With --fix: the optional items go with the essential ones.
doctor_option_ci: Never asks (CI): only shows the state, or installs with --fix --yes.
doctor_option_no_interactive: Never asks, even on a terminal.
doctor_class_essential: essential: an enabled check does not run without it, and there is no other runner.
doctor_class_unused: unused: no enabled check needs it.
doctor_disable: or switch the check off for one run: {command}
doctor_after_ready: After the installation: nothing essential or optional is missing.
doctor_after_missing: After the installation, still missing: essential {essential}; optional {optional}.
doctor_fix_needs_terminal: Without a terminal the doctor does not ask: use jgates doctor --fix --yes to install the essential items (and --include-optional for the optional ones).
doctor_hint_fix: To install what is missing: jgates doctor --fix (on a terminal) or jgates doctor --fix --yes.
